title: Registry Api Options Schema
description: Generates a HTTP api class under src/app/pages/<name>/data/state.

name.description: The name for the new api.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the api?

project.description: The name of the project where the file should be added.

path.description: The folder where the file is created, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to src/app/pages/<name>/data/state.
